summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 21, 2026, to disclose a TR-1 major holdings notification received from Bank of America Corporation. The notification reports that Bank of America's aggregate voting rights in Smith & Nephew crossed a threshold on August 19, 2026, resulting in 2.888834% total voting rights (2.461592% via shares and 0.427242% via financial instruments, including swaps and options). This is a routine regulatory disclosure of a shareholder's position change, not a special-situation event. The filing includes standard details on voting rights and controlled undertakings. No transaction, strategic initiative, or corporate action is involved. What to watch: any further threshold crossings by major shareholders that could signal increased activist or strategic interest.
